summary.text: Chris Freeland is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 6 since 2019 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Chris Freeland was born in Benton, Kentucky.
He earned a bachelor of arts in history and advertising and a master's degree in communications from Murray State University.
He has been a member of the Lions Club, the Kentucky Broadcasters Association, the NRA, and the Marshall County Chamber of Commerce.
Freeland assumed office on January 1, 2019, succeeding Will Coursey (D).
In the 2025-2026 session he served on the House Agriculture, Appropriations and Revenue, Local Government, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
